newsitem.title: CANADA: Westburne securitizes C$125 mln of accounts.
newsitem.headline: Westburne securitizes C$125 mln of accounts.

text.p: Westburne Inc said on Tuesday that it agreed to securitize up to C$125 million of its accounts receivables.

Proceeds of the securitization with an unidentified investment dealer would be used to reduce bank debt in an equivalent amount, Westburne said. It would allow the company to restructure its balance sheet, reduce outstanding debt further and improve its debt/equity ratio and financial covenants, it said.

The securitization program generated an annual pre-tax savings through expense reductions of C$1 million in 1996, and Westburne estimated that such savings would increase to C$1.4 million annually afterward, it said.
